messages:
Asha (PM): Kicking off Q3 planning for Private deploys — want to align on SLAs for control plane, packaging signoff, and air-gap e2e tests. Short sync?
Marc (Eng): +1. Need clarity on minimal contract (health endpoints, readiness, metrics) we guarantee.
Sam (Infra): From infra POV: we can commit to 99.9% control-plane uptime for VPC control plane. On-prem SLA depends on customer infra; propose we separate 'control plane availability' vs 'agent/worker availability' in SOW.
Leila (Security): Air-gapped checklist first pass: offline KMS integration, no outbound telemetry by default, signed packages only. I'll share a checklist doc later.
Diego (Solutions): Customers are asking for an "installation SOW" template and a supported install window. Also want clear rollback steps and escalation path.
Asha (PM): Good — propose OKRs: (1) ship Private GA with Control Plane SLA doc + SOW template; (2) deliver signed packaging + airgap e2e harness; (3) publish onboarding runbook + complete 2 customer pilots. Thoughts?
Marc (Eng): OKR 1 depends on acceptance criteria for failover. Suggest a minimal acceptance test matrix: control-plane health, leader election, leader failover <30s, config sync correctness.
Sam (Infra): For packaging: artifact repo layout, signed tarball + sha256, and a small installer script. Example build snippet: 
`````
make package-private VERSION=1.2.0
sha256sum dist/private-1.2.0.tar.gz > dist/private-1.2.0.tar.gz.sha256
`````
Marc (Eng): Also ensure helm chart supports airgap patterns: imagePullPolicy=IfNotPresent + documented image mirror instructions.
Leila (Security): Must include HSM/KMS integration docs and explicit network requirements (allowed CIDRs, no egress by default). Add requirement: telemetry disabled unless customer opts in.
Oz (Legal): For SOW, we need clearly defined support boundaries and a warranty/liability clause for customer-modified on-prem installs. I'll draft standard language.
Diego (Solutions): Pilot proposal: two customers — one VPC control-plane with dedicated agents, one full on-prem airgap. Each pilot = 4-week engagement with defined success criteria.
Asha (PM): Timeline suggestion: Week1 finalize SLA+SOW; Week3 publish packaging + signed artifacts; Week6 start pilots; Week10 GA. Can we hit that if we prioritize?
Marc (Eng): Tight but feasible if we lock acceptance tests and focus eng time on packaging + failover work. I can allocate sprint time.
Sam (Infra): Need CI to run offline e2e harness and signing pipeline. @deploy-bot can you queue a dry-run job for the packaging branch?
deploy-bot: CI build queued for branch feature/private-packaging-e2e #453 — logs: http://ci.internal/453 :hammer_and_wrench: 
Asha (PM): Action items: Marc — acceptance test matrix; Sam — packaging + CI job + runbook; Leila — security checklist; Oz — SOW draft; Diego — pilot candidate list. Sync Friday 11:00am. :calendar:
Marc (Eng): noted.
Leila (Security): noted, I'll upload checklist before Friday.
Diego (Solutions): will ping potential pilot customers and share shortlist.
Oz (Legal): will circulate SOW draft by Thurs EOD.
Sam (Infra): I'll create the Jenkins job and share runbook link here.
Asha (PM): Thanks all — I'll create a short Confluence page and link it once it's up. :tada:
